pr_body:
Fix the structures so that they are compliant with the stricter checks
of GCC 10.x, and at the same time correct a bug that was present in the
handling of the GAP Start Advertising BTP command.

Fixes #28375.

Signed-off-by: Carles Cufi <carles.cufi@nordicsemi.no>
pr_comments:
Is it me or the handling of the GAP Advertising command was completely broken? Unless my understanding was incorrect:

https://github.com/intel/auto-pts/blob/master/doc/btp_spec.txt#L300

> Can most of these uint8_t FOOO[] be uin8_t *FOO instead?

Not really. These are structs that describe data in a contiguous protocol buffer, and the buffer contains protocol data as it was received (i.e. we can't put pointers in there or such). `uint8_t foo[]` is just a helper to quickly get access to the position within the buffer where some variable-length data begins.
